items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: And so he taught me and I kept practicing at it, practicing.

ctx.x: You pop the reed; instead of making a noise, you have "pop," just like you pop, like you slap anything flat, you know. And so he taught me and I kept practicing at it, practicing. Then they called me the "King of the Slap Tongue." Then I got more work than I could ever handle. And all the guys that fired me and did me dirt, I says, "I'll get even with them." I'd take the job and I wouldn't go on it.
